canadian_tire_audit.note: No new general-retail duplicates were created. Official Newton store page confirms 7599 King George Boulevard and lists Scott Road 7878 120 Street and White Rock 3059 152 Street, all already present. The bounded OSM comparison is not an individual operator verification of every branch.

limitations: Download date does not verify current operation of community records. Some addresses/cities are absent in OSM and remain blank.
All points are approximate; coordinates may be locator pins, feature bounding-box centres or civic parcel points, not entrances.
Staples directory crawl covers city markers within the regional bounds; wireless sub-listings at the same branches are excluded.

Dollarama public locator was queried with a 70 km radius, checked for one complete response page, then clipped to the exact box. Coming-soon branches are excluded except two flags contradicted by reviewed current branch pages; these exceptions retain their review date.
Two Dollarama Central City records have distinct operator branch IDs and differing secondary-address labels. They remain separate operator listings despite nearby approximate pins.
H&M and Simons manual reviews retain their recorded review date until reviewed again. Future Simons downtown Vancouver opening is not included.
Walmart and Costco are department-store destinations only when OSM explicitly tags department_store/wholesale; they may also appear under Groceries.
Winners and Marshalls are grouped with clothing; Simons is grouped as a department store. Canadian Tire remains Hardware store.
No letterboxes, courier-only shops, Bay or Nordstrom locations are included.
refresh: Run python3 scripts/refresh_retail_services.py for fresh sources, or replay the retained evidence with --from-raw.
Review manual operator checks and unmatched official/community branches before publication.
